fato_historico: 1920: Ray Chapman of the Cleveland Indians is hit on the head by a fastball thrown by Carl Mays of the New York Yankees. Next day, Chapman will become the second player to die from injuries sustained in a Major League Baseball game.
energia_do_dia: Today may bring a sudden shift in your perspective, much like a fleeting moment that changes the course of a long game. It is a good time to embrace your gentle side and protect your inner spark. Consider how your unique energy impacts those around you, turning obstacles into lessons of grace and resilient spirit.
frase_do_dia: Every unexpected turn is merely a chance to rewrite your beautiful story.
significado_numero: Represents the star of hope and navigating through dark times gracefully.
conselho: Protect your precious energy and walk forward with kindness in your heart.
